title: Grid valid_cells mask for irregular board shapes
description: Add valid_cells field to grid/hex_grid zones — an array of [col,row] pairs defining which cells exist. Runtime stores as HashSet<usize>. grid_get/grid_set/movement all check membership. Cells outside mask treated as out-of-bounds. Unblocks Chinese Checkers (star on hex grid), polyomino boards, cross/L-shaped boards. Also fix hex_6 adjacency which is declared but resolves to 8-direction vectors.
close_reason: Implemented valid_cells mask on grid/hex_grid zones + hex_6 adjacency fix. 34 new tests across Rust and Python.
